messages:
Emma: Heads up — external assessment incoming from RedTeamHQ starting Mon 2026-04-06 (2-week window). Scope: staging infra, Dedicated infra, KMS integration, RBAC mappings, audit logs. Need to confirm access model and evidence handoff. Can eng-security + eng-sre confirm ephemeral role approach and evidence export plan? :raising_hand:

David: Quick take — ephemeral assessor roles via IAM-proxy is fine. Time-limited creds, scoped S3 presigned uploads for evidence, and no direct KMS decrypt handed out. I'll sketch steps below. :+1:

David: ```yaml
# ephemeral role request example
ephemeral_role_request:
  role: assessor-temp
  duration_seconds: 3600
  allowed_actions:
    - s3:GetObject
    - s3:PutObject
    - logs:DescribeLogGroups
    - logs:GetLogEvents
```

Maria: Any risk to customer-facing endpoints? We need a canary + rollback plan if configs are touched. Also product needs a freeze window if changes required.

Sachin: For KMS: we cannot give external assessors Decrypt permissions. Propose a wrapping flow: assessors can request wrapped keys or provide signed evidence blobs to us, we unwrap for internal verification. Also require CloudTrail + internal audit exporter to capture key usage. Retention target: 180 days for this assessment evidence.

David: Ops playbook snippet for presigned upload: ```bash
# generate presigned upload link (24h)
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/assessor/$(date +%s).tgz --expires-in 86400
```

oncall-bot: @emma scheduled maintenance notice: infra deploy 2026-04-10 02:00-04:00 UTC — may overlap with vendor activity, flagging here.

Emma: Noted. Proposal: remediation complete by 2026-04-20, retest window 2026-04-27 to 2026-04-30 (vendor needs 5 business days to re-run). Thoughts? :calendar:

Sachin: +1. I'll raise a Jira epic and add a remediation tracker sheet. Labels: security, external-assessment, redteamhq. Evidence checklist to include: scope doc, RBAC mapping, CloudTrail exports, KMS audit logs, screenshots, fix PR links, and presigned evidence archive links.

Maria: I'll block product freeze 2026-04-19 through 2026-04-21 for config-sensitive changes. No releases then.

Emma: Action items: David -> create ephemeral role + presigned buckets; Sachin -> create Jira epic + evidence checklist; Maria -> block freeze window; I'll coordinate vendor handshake + SSO invites. I'll DM vendor details and update this thread when done. :white_check_mark:

David: Done: created bucket s3://redwood-pt-evidence with versioning and lifecycle 365d. Created IAM role assessor-temp with scoped S3 Get/Put and explicit Deny on kms:Decrypt.

David: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"]},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```

Emma: Thanks. Remediation tracker: https://jira.redwood.company/browse/SEC-2026 (Sachin, please add assessment tasks and link evidence). I'll schedule a 15m sync with vendor and owners tomorrow.

oncall-bot: This thread has been pinned to #eng-security for the assessment lifecycle.
